description: Zero claims extracted but reconciliation status returned CLEAN
root_cause: No rule tested for an empty claim list; every other rule is vacuously silent with no rows, so an unread table exported a green badge

description: 0 claims extracted from a 5-page document holding 12
root_cause: pdfplumber ruled detection returned the boxed header block as the table: a header, one row (the third header line) and none of the claim data, which sits below the ruling. Nothing checked that the chosen table contained data.

description: Claim # / OneClaim # mapped to nothing, so no claim-number column existed
root_cause: normalize_label stripped # entirely, leaving "claim oneclaim" with no token saying it is a number

description: Three columns labelled Total; Ind/BI and Alloc Exp unmapped
root_cause: Repeated parent labels are disambiguated only by the child row beneath them (Reserves/Recoveries/Incurred), and the trade abbreviations ind, bi, alloc were absent from the component vocabulary

description: 12 of 12 claims found but every date and money field null (24 R-07)
root_cause: Each claim is a three-line record whose fields are distributed across the lines: name on line A, identifier and status on line B, dates and money on line C. The header is three lines, one per record line. The engine models one header and one line per claim, so only line B survives and the rest folds into the description.

description: AIG-style identifier smearing rejected 8 of 12 legitimate claim ids
root_cause: The identifier-shape consensus introduced for Liberty rejected cells where a neighbouring column bled in, because the smeared cell has a different shape. A false negative created by a previous generalized fix.

description: A single-claim report extracted zero claims
root_cause: The recurrence floor required a shape to appear at least twice, so a shape appearing once -- an ordinary one-claim loss run -- was rejected entirely.

description: 162 rows extracted against a printed count of 28; 152 of them from inside the loss run pages
root_cause: Each claim is a stacked multi-line detail block. Continuation lines land in the claim-number column, and build_claim accepts any non-empty value there as a new claim. Continuation folding only fires when that cell is empty.

description: 10 further rows extracted from page 54, a financial statement outside the loss run, with claim_number '0'
root_cause: Extraction runs over every page of a compound document; no test that an identifier-shaped value is present

description: Loss run occupies pages 39-51 of a 99-page board packet; the other 86 pages are municipal meeting material
root_cause: No notion of which pages constitute the loss-run section of a compound document

description: 84 candidate rows with every date and money field null (168 R-07 findings)
root_cause: Not yet root-caused; row detection succeeds but field association fails
Letterhead detection picked a header fragment

description: 0 claims; no headers detected at all
root_cause: Not yet root-caused; combines scanned pages, Italian labels and EU numerics

description: 6 of 23 pages carry no text layer
root_cause: Vision path disabled in the cold run; OCR contribution not yet measured

description: Two columns, Total Incurred and Net Incurred, both mapped to incurred_total; the second was silently dropped and the document reported CLEAN
root_cause: map_headers demoted the losing column to unmapped and nothing downstream recorded that a materially distinct money column had been discarded. Arithmetic still balanced over the surviving values.

description: Three columns printed Total; two were discarded without trace
root_cause: Same mechanism. Disambiguated here by the child header row, but where that is absent the ambiguity must be preserved rather than resolved by guessing.

description: 12 claims extracted with every date and every amount null (24 R-07 errors); each claim occupies three printed lines and only the line carrying the identifier was read
root_cause: The engine modelled one header line and one line per claim. AIG heads its table with three lines of labels, one per line of a three-line record: claimant, then identifier and status, then dates and money. Reading line by line, the claim was built from the identifier line alone and the other two lines were folded into its description or warned about.

description: Money read one column left of where it belonged, so an amount printed under Ind/BI Paid arrived as Med/PD Paid
root_cause: Column boundaries were taken from the midpoints between header cells, but money prints right-aligned under a left-aligned label and sits past that midpoint. Invisible on page 2, where every amount is .00; on page 4 it would have moved 15,000.00 into medical.

description: Two R-01 errors reported against a carrier that had made none, totalling 41,880 and 2,403
root_cause: R-01 read an unprinted paid total as zero, and a first attempt at the fix summed whatever paid components happened to be present. CNA prints an Expenses Total this engine does not map, so the indemnity alone stood in for the paid figure and the unmapped expenses were reported as the carrier's arithmetic error.
